name: The tray in Metcalfe's window
when: Rita's back room open (rung 2) and Frank has fenced once; Wayne in the back room
offer: Metcalfe leaves a tray of medals in the window overnight. Rita would take them, if she did not know whose they were.

keys.how: the back door in the alley
a lift in the day while Hal is at Rita's (Monday 11:00)

steps.words: Put Metcalfe's window in and took the tray of medals. Hal Metcalfe never forgets his own goods.
lines: Put Metcalfe's window in and took the tray of medals. Hal Metcalfe never forgets his own goods.

pay.band_note: fence at a third of retail; honest value 90 pounds

ledger: Wayne says Metcalfe leaves a tray of medals in his window overnight.
returns: Hal never forgets his own goods; the buy-back within 7 game days
